duration-fast.$description: Quick micro-interactions such as button taps, icon states, and tooltips.

duration-base.$description: Standard UI transitions like dropdown disclosures and tab switches.

duration-slow.$description: Large container layout expansions and full dialog transitions.

ease-out.$description: Decelerating curve for elements entering the screen or expanding.

ease-in-out.$description: Smooth acceleration and deceleration for continuous repositioning.

spring-snappy.$description: High-responsiveness physical spring with minimal overshoot for interactive controls.

spring-soft.$description: Gentle, forgiving spring for ambient cards and non-blocking overlays.

motion-enter.$description: Universal enter transition token for incoming elements.

motion-exit.$description: Swift exit curve to avoid keeping the user waiting on dismiss.

motion-feedback.$description: Spring physics feedback for direct user interactions.

motion-emphasis.$description: Gentle spring for attention cues and subtle focus shifts.

modal-enter.$description: Physics spring for dialog scale and backdrop opacity.

tooltip-enter.$description: Rapid slide and opacity fade for contextual hover text.

accordion-expand.$description: Smooth height expansion curve and chevron rotation.

dropdown-open.$description: Snappy menu disclosure with vertical anchor.
